logline: The devas celebrate Gajendra's deliverance; Huhu returns home, Gajendra receives four-armed sārūpya-mukti through Hari's touch, and after speaking blessings the Lord sounds Pāñcajanya and departs on Garuḍa with Gajendra.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam Canto 8 Chapter 4; originally worded contemporary Telugu/Hindi/English child-friendly narration, not copied English translation
source.verification_notes: 8.4.1–2: devas, sages and Gandharvas praise Hari, flowers/kettledrums, songs and dancing; no recordings are sourced. 8.4.5: restored Huhu circumambulates Lord, bows and returns to Gandharvaloka; restoration itself at 8.4.3–4 was already narrated in E05. 8.4.6: Hari's touch immediately frees Gajendra from ignorance and bestows spiritual four-armed, yellow-robed sārūpya (distinct from both original quadrupedal elephant and Hari). 8.4.13: after Gajendra liberation, Lord goes to His abode riding Garuda with liberated Gajendra. 8.4.14–15: hearing/story remembrance blessings. 8.4.16 and 17–24: Hari addresses Gajendra and praises recollection of Him and sacred sites/attributes, summarized not verbatim. 8.4.25: morning prayer/eternal spiritual benefit described, without claiming universal modern material reward. 8.4.26: Lord sounds Pāñcajanya and mounts Garuda to depart. Episode sequences the later explanation/flashback E05 before showing spiritual form E06 as editorial disclosure; this does NOT claim Gajendra's sārūpya was delayed from the original touch. S01: SB 8.4.1, 8.4.2 straightforward original paraphrase, staging separated from scripture. S02: SB 8.4.5 straightforward original paraphrase, staging separated from scripture. S03: SB 8.4.6 straightforward original paraphrase, staging separated from scripture.

core_preserved: All devas/sages/Gandharvas praise Hari, shower flowers and play celestial music (8.4.1–2).
Huhu, already restored to Gandharva identity by 8.4.3–4, bows and returns to Gandharvaloka (8.4.5).
By Lord's touch Gajendra immediately receives sārūpya-mukti, four arms and yellow garments, released from material ignorance (8.4.6).
Hari grants blessings and describes remembrance of His divine forms and sites in morning devotion (8.4.14–25).
The Lord blows the Pāñcajanya conch, mounts Garuda and leaves; Gajendra accompanies Him to His divine abode (8.4.13,26).
changes: The chapter's immediate sārūpya after rescue is visually shown in E06 because E05 first explains the backstories. This is editorial reveal order ONLY, not a new event in time; scene text discloses this.
The current visual identity approved by owner includes a distinct four-armed yellow-garbed spiritual associate for liberated Gajendra; do not make ordinary elephant grow human arms.
No copyrighted published verse translations, exact Sanskrit recitation, existing recorded kirtan or commercial music are introduced.
Celestial flowers, praise and drums are verse-grounded but voice/musical performances are not generated/approved; any original score cues remain future plans.
Source lists many sacred names/locations at 8.4.17–24; age-accessible condensed narrator wording explicitly not a literal mantra or a replacement for exact recitation.
No fabricated direct speech from Huhu, Gajendra or Narayana in the sourced narrator-only script; optional later direct speaking portraits would need new authorized lines.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: When Hari delivered Gajendra, the devas rejoiced.

text.hi: जब हरि ने गजेन्द्र को बचाया, देवता प्रसन्न हुए।
text.en: When Hari delivered Gajendra, the devas rejoiced.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Sages and Gandharvas praised the Lord.

text.hi: ऋषियों और गंधर्वों ने भी भगवान की स्तुति की।
text.en: Sages and Gandharvas praised the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Flowers showered down from the sky.

text.hi: आकाश से फूलों की वर्षा हुई।
text.en: Flowers showered down from the sky.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Everyone honored the Lord's compassion.

text.hi: सबने भगवान की करुणा की प्रशंसा की।
text.en: Everyone honored the Lord's compassion.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Heavenly kettledrums sounded.

text.hi: दिव्य नगाड़े बज उठे।
text.en: Heavenly kettledrums sounded.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Gandharvas sang and danced with joy.

text.hi: गंधर्व खुशी से गाने और नाचने लगे।
text.en: The Gandharvas sang and danced with joy.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Siddhas and Charanas praised the Supreme.

text.hi: सिद्ध और चारण भी परम भगवान की स्तुति करने लगे।
text.en: The Siddhas and Charanas praised the Supreme.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Their joy celebrated Gajendra's wonderful deliverance.

text.te: ఈ ఆనందం గజేంద్రుడి గొప్ప విముక్తిని గుర్తుచేసింది.
text.hi: यह उल्लास गजेन्द्र के अद्भुत उद्धार का उत्सव था।
text.en: Their joy celebrated Gajendra's wonderful deliverance.

source_attribution.note: Original short interpretive closing narration connecting the scripture's praise and flowers (8.4.1–2) to Gajendra's deliverance; not an additional quoted verse.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Huhu had regained his Gandharva form.

text.te: హూహూ తన గంధర్వ రూపాన్ని తిరిగి పొందాడు.
text.hi: हूहू ने अपना गंधर्व रूप वापस पा लिया।
text.en: Huhu had regained his Gandharva form.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana's mercy had ended his curse.

text.te: నారాయణుడి కరుణ వల్ల అతని శాపం ముగిసింది.
text.hi: नारायण की दया से उसका श्राप समाप्त हुआ।
text.en: Narayana's mercy had ended his curse.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Huhu respectfully circled the Lord.

text.te: హూహూ భక్తితో భగవంతుని చుట్టూ ప్రదక్షిణ చేశాడు.
text.hi: हूहू ने श्रद्धा से भगवान की परिक्रमा की।
text.en: Huhu respectfully circled the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Then he bowed his head.

text.hi: फिर सिर झुकाकर प्रणाम किया।
text.en: Then he bowed his head.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: With the devas looking on, he returned to Gandharvaloka.

text.te: దేవతలు చూస్తుండగా అతను గంధర్వలోకానికి తిరిగి వెళ్లాడు.
text.hi: देवताओं के सामने वह गंधर्व लोक लौट गया।
text.en: With the devas looking on, he returned to Gandharvaloka.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was freed from the burden of his former curse.

text.te: తన తప్పు వల్ల వచ్చిన బంధనం నుంచి విముక్తి పొందాడు.
text.hi: वह अपने पुराने बंधन से मुक्त हो गया।
text.en: He was freed from the burden of his former curse.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was restored to his original place.

text.te: ఇప్పుడు అతను మళ్లీ తన అసలు స్థానంలో ఉన్నాడు.
text.hi: अब वह फिर अपने मूल लोक में था।
text.en: He was restored to his original place.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Thus Huhu's earlier-life story reached its resolution.

text.hi: इस तरह हूहू की पिछली जन्म की कथा पूरी हुई।
text.en: Thus Huhu's earlier-life story reached its resolution.

source_attribution.note: Original serial narrative closure of Huhu's source-grounded gratitude and departure from 8.4.5; not independently quoted scriptural speech.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra's deliverance brought a deeper spiritual gift.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడి విముక్తికి మరో దివ్యమైన ఫలితం ఉంది.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र के उद्धार का एक और दिव्य फल था।
text.en: Gajendra's deliverance brought a deeper spiritual gift.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: By Narayana's touch, his ignorance was removed.

text.hi: नारायण के स्पर्श से उसका अज्ञान मिट गया।
text.en: By Narayana's touch, his ignorance was removed.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was freed from material bondage too.

text.te: భౌతిక బంధనాల నుంచి కూడా అతను విముక్తి పొందాడు.
text.hi: वह भौतिक बंधनों से भी मुक्त हो गया।
text.en: He was freed from material bondage too.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: This liberation is called sārūpya-mukti.

text.hi: इस मुक्ति को सारूप्य-मुक्ति कहते हैं।
text.en: This liberation is called sārūpya-mukti.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He received a divine form with four arms.

text.te: అతనికి నాలుగు చేతులున్న దివ్య రూపం లభించింది.
text.hi: उसे चार भुजाओं वाला दिव्य रूप मिला।
text.en: He received a divine form with four arms.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Dressed in yellow, his spiritual form resembled the Lord's.

text.te: పసుపు వస్త్రాలు ధరించిన ఆ రూపం భగవంతునికి సాదృశ్యం కలిగి ఉంది.
text.hi: पीले वस्त्रों वाला वह रूप भगवान के समान दिव्य था।
text.en: Dressed in yellow, his spiritual form resembled the Lord's.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: It was no longer an ordinary elephant body.

text.hi: वह साधारण हाथी का शरीर नहीं था।
text.en: It was no longer an ordinary elephant body.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra became a spiritual associate of Narayana.

text.hi: गजेन्द्र भगवान नारायण का दिव्य सहचर बन गया।
text.en: Gajendra became a spiritual associate of Narayana.
